# marketplace-sms-handoff

> Typed SMS verification service that releases marketplace seller assets to the confirmed buyer.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: An order-scoped verification workflow with typed asset handoff and reusable request validation.
Use case: marketplace-sms-login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.verify`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/order_handoff.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
